title: Design Studio Selections Files Held by One Buyer
content:
**Standard.** A buyer may hold up to 2 Design Studio Selections files, one for each open to-be-built purchase agreement; a file is never opened for an inventory home.

**The standard restated as conditions**

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| The purchase agreement is an open to-be-built agreement and the buyer holds fewer than 2 design studio files | A file may be held for that agreement, one file for that agreement |
| The buyer already holds 2 design studio files | No further file is held by that buyer |
| The home is an inventory home | No design studio file is opened for it |

**Hypothetical cases**

- A buyer with one open to-be-built agreement holds one Design Studio Selections file for it. If the same buyer signs a second to-be-built agreement in another community, a second file may be held for the second agreement.
- A buyer who already holds 2 Design Studio Selections files does not hold a third, whatever agreement it would serve.
- A buyer who buys a finished inventory home has no Design Studio Selections file for that home.
